'''The Avenue''' was the central district of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Talaos City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Avenue appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
